query: SELECT f.id, f.name, (SELECT count(*) FROM folder_templates AS ft JOIN templates AS t ON t.account_id = ft.account_id AND t.id = ft.template_id WHERE ft.account_id = f.account_id AND ft.folder_id = f.id AND ft.user_id = f.owner_user_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "count!" FROM folders AS f WHERE f.account_id = $1 AND f.owner_user_id = $2 AND f.kind = 'templates' ORDER BY lower(f.name), f.id
